headline: Overnight Russian barrage kills nine in Kyiv, as air defense struggle with U.S. continues
context: Ballistic missiles tore into five districts of the Ukrainian capital before dawn Saturday. President Trump is now walking back a promised boost to Ukraine's missile defense systems.

sources.name: NPR
